title: CousinCraft
description: Vanilla adventure-based modpack made for playing with my cousins. Overhauling world gen without adding new blocks.
body:
## Description
Lightweight vanilla adventure-focused modpack made for playing with my cousins (low-end laptops). Overhauling world generations without adding new blocks

## Contents
- Terrain mods: Terralith, Blooming Biosphere, Geophilic, Hearths, Incendium, etc
- Structure mods: Yung's, Moog's, Camps Castles Carriages, CTOV, Explorify, Luki Grand Capitals, etc
- Animation mods: Fresh Animations, Not Enough Animations, Explosive Enhancements, Eating Animation, etc
 
- Many QOL mods (Falling Tree, Waystones, Inmis backpacks) + mods/resource packs to beautify MC (Colorful containers, Dramatic Skies, Loading BGs, Visual Workbench, Visuality) just to list a few

## Credits
**None** of the mods here are made by me, all credits goes to the respective creators

Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/
